verdict.rationale: Rive ships open-source runtime SDKs (rive-runtime on GitHub) across web, mobile, game engines, and platforms, backed by extensive first-party docs on integration, data binding, and rendering (rive-docs-8, rive-docs-21, rive-gh-1, rive-gh-2), which is the core of 'official SDKs' for AI-native/agentic building. missing for 10: independent third-party hands-on validation of SDK quality/completeness beyond vendor docs, and no dedicated language-specific SDK reference pages (e.g., versioned API docs per platform) in the pack.
